description: Use this when someone asks what a mining company's newest drill holes mean: where they sit, how they compare with the company's other holes, or whether they hit the company's targets. Give it the company's ticker or name. Returns the company's 3D model as its 6ix.com page shows it: hole and metre counts, each recent hole's interval with the most grade × length and its rank among every hole in its deposit or project (none when it is the only one), whether it hit, extended or missed each target the company published (with the company's expected grade and width), the company's own words about each target, and the cautionary statement that applies to exploration targets. Every company whose drill releases print hole coordinates has one, built by 6ix from those releases and labelled so (source, placedHoles, newestRelease), unless the company hid it; a company that showed its own files has those too.

company.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

name: get_drill_model

newestRelease.description: The newest release the model uses (ISO 8601)

placedHoles.description: Holes placed from the collars the releases print

source.description: Who built the model from what, e.g. Built by 6ix from White Gold Corp.’s releases

title: 3D drill model
